text: Marine concrete (intake structure, screen chamber, pumphouse, outfall diffuser blocks) shall be XS3 per section 10; steelwork in the marine zone shall be protected to ISO 12944 category CX (immersion / splash) or be of duplex stainless steel; the screens and rakes shall be designed for the jellyfish load of DP-OWNR-0019 and for the debris load of the storm suspended solids (DP-OWNR-0017).
